def dist(x: Float[Array, '16'], y: Float[Array, '16'], z: Float[Array, '16'], L: Integer, periodicX: Boolean, periodicY: Boolean, periodicZ: Boolean):
    bprobe_trace = []
    ' Computes distances between all particles and places the result in a matrix such that the ij th matrix entry corresponds to the distance between particle i and j '
    N = len(x)
    bprobe_v0 = np.tile(x, (N, 1))
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v0))
    xtemp = bprobe_v0
    bprobe_v1 = xtemp.T
    bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v1))
    bprobe_v2 = xtemp - bprobe_v1
    bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v2))
    dx = bprobe_v2
    bprobe_v3 = np.tile(y, (N, 1))
    bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v3))
    ytemp = bprobe_v3
    bprobe_v4 = ytemp.T
    bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v4))
    bprobe_v5 = ytemp - bprobe_v4
    bprobe_trace.append((5, bprobe_v5))
    dy = bprobe_v5
    bprobe_v6 = np.tile(z, (N, 1))
    bprobe_trace.append((6, bprobe_v6))
    ztemp = bprobe_v6
    bprobe_v7 = ztemp.T
    bprobe_trace.append((7, bprobe_v7))
    bprobe_v8 = ztemp - bprobe_v7
    bprobe_trace.append((8, bprobe_v8))
    dz = bprobe_v8
    bprobe_v9 = dx > L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((9, bprobe_v9))
    bprobe_v10 = dx > L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((12, bprobe_v10))
    bprobe_v11 = dx[bprobe_v10]
    bprobe_trace.append((10, bprobe_v11))
    bprobe_v12 = bprobe_v11 - L
    bprobe_trace.append((11, bprobe_v12))
    dx[bprobe_v9] = bprobe_v12
    bprobe_v13 = dx < -L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((13, bprobe_v13))
    bprobe_v14 = dx < -L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((16, bprobe_v14))
    bprobe_v15 = dx[bprobe_v14]
    bprobe_trace.append((14, bprobe_v15))
    bprobe_v16 = bprobe_v15 + L
    bprobe_trace.append((15, bprobe_v16))
    dx[bprobe_v13] = bprobe_v16
    bprobe_v17 = dy > L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((17, bprobe_v17))
    bprobe_v18 = dy > L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((20, bprobe_v18))
    bprobe_v19 = dy[bprobe_v18]
    bprobe_trace.append((18, bprobe_v19))
    bprobe_v20 = bprobe_v19 - L
    bprobe_trace.append((19, bprobe_v20))
    dy[bprobe_v17] = bprobe_v20
    bprobe_v21 = dy < -L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((21, bprobe_v21))
    bprobe_v22 = dy < -L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((24, bprobe_v22))
    bprobe_v23 = dy[bprobe_v22]
    bprobe_trace.append((22, bprobe_v23))
    bprobe_v24 = bprobe_v23 + L
    bprobe_trace.append((23, bprobe_v24))
    dy[bprobe_v21] = bprobe_v24
    bprobe_v25 = dz > L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((25, bprobe_v25))
    bprobe_v26 = dz > L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((28, bprobe_v26))
    bprobe_v27 = dz[bprobe_v26]
    bprobe_trace.append((26, bprobe_v27))
    bprobe_v28 = bprobe_v27 - L
    bprobe_trace.append((27, bprobe_v28))
    dz[bprobe_v25] = bprobe_v28
    bprobe_v29 = dz < -L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((29, bprobe_v29))
    bprobe_v30 = dz < -L / 2
    bprobe_trace.append((32, bprobe_v30))
    bprobe_v31 = dz[bprobe_v30]
    bprobe_trace.append((30, bprobe_v31))
    bprobe_v32 = bprobe_v31 + L
    bprobe_trace.append((31, bprobe_v32))
    dz[bprobe_v29] = bprobe_v32
    bprobe_v33 = dx ** 2
    bprobe_trace.append((33, bprobe_v33))
    bprobe_v34 = dy ** 2
    bprobe_trace.append((36, bprobe_v34))
    bprobe_v35 = bprobe_v33 + bprobe_v34
    bprobe_trace.append((34, bprobe_v35))
    bprobe_v36 = dz ** 2
    bprobe_trace.append((37, bprobe_v36))
    bprobe_v37 = bprobe_v35 + bprobe_v36
    bprobe_trace.append((35, bprobe_v37))
    bprobe_v38 = np.sqrt(bprobe_v37)
    bprobe_trace.append((38, bprobe_v38))
    d = bprobe_v38
    bprobe_v39 = d == 0
    bprobe_trace.append((39, bprobe_v39))
    d[bprobe_v39] = -1
    return bprobe_trace
